mostWorthwhile.text: Breaking starch down in stages was most worthwhile: the shorter chains made the path from starch to separate glucose units clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The protein step felt least involving because it was the only offered combination and its result was fairly predictable.

surprise.text: Bile spreading fat into droplets and enzymes breaking the molecules apart turned out to be two distinct jobs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a purpose, though the compatible options supplied the pairings.

continue.text: I'd probably continue for another chapter to see how the small food molecules get into the body, although the final protein step felt predictable.
